endorsements.quote: However, integrating CDSS into the daily clinical routine using real-world data requires rigorous clinical validation in a real-world environment before implementation in clinical practice.
Additionally, AI models will need to be explainable, describing why and which parameters impacted a model ’s decision.

unlisted_practices: Address regulatory and privacy issues for AI-based clinical decision support.
Establish new rules defining where responsibility lies for mistakes made with AI-based clinical decision support.
Continue research evaluating and building trust in AI/physician collaboration workflows.
Develop further approaches to detect and mitigate bias in AI models to ensure generalizability and fairness.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/discussion paper discussing collaborative strategies and challenges for deploying AI-based clinical decision support systems.
